Recorded claim:
After native tree header appearance was removed upstream, the chat nick list and log headers needed explicit CSS. Review found that putting the Mac replacement styles in shared chat.css changed Linux and Windows, so the final patch grouped both Mac header selectors in the macOS stylesheet. For an upstream appearance removal, inspect each platform and keep platform-specific replacements scoped to their theme file.
